groups.title: Add UserService.updateUser (PUT /users/:id)
groups.why: updateUser() calls the new HttpClient.put() and the new validateUserPatch(); the service test gains a put stub in makeService and tests for the new method.

groups.title: Track cache hit/miss statistics
groups.why: UserCache gains hits/misses counters, increments them in get(), exposes stats(); createApp surfaces it and a new test file covers it.

groups.title: Add JSDoc to loadConfig, createLogger and slugify
groups.why: Comment-only hunks in three unrelated modules; the only thing linking them is that they are all documentation.

groups.title: Reject malformed email domains
groups.why: EMAIL_RE no longer accepts empty, consecutive or trailing dots in the domain; a new test file pins this via isValidEmail().

groups.title: Mechanical changes
groups.why: typescript 5.4.5 -> 5.5.4 (manifest + lockfile), regenerated routes file, and a whitespace-only reindent of tsconfig.json.

notes: src/http/client.ts#0 is a MIXED hunk: a JSDoc line on post() (docs) plus the new put() method (update-user). Assigned to update-user as the dominant concern; no hunk-level grouping can be fully right.
The docs group has no structural links at all. Only embeddings (all three are comment-only) can tie it together; otherwise expect three misc singletons.
validation.ts is split: #0 is the email fix, #1 is update-user. tests/users/validation.test.ts belongs to the email fix even though it imports the same module that validateUserPatch lives in.
tests/users/userService.test.ts#0 only adds a `put` stub to a test helper; it links to update-user through the identifier put.
src/index.ts#0 links to cache-stats only through stats().
tsconfig.json#0 changes every line but is whitespace-only.
